name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.normal.robot.RobotEditNameActivity
description: When a user taps an AI account's name while creating or editing it, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK opens a page to change that name and return it to the previous screen.
disableEffect: Users can no longer enter or change an AI account's name in the create and edit flows.
